gaps.sentence: ___ the fact that the evidence was thin, the jury convicted him.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite the fact that + clause' converts a clause into the noun phrase that despite requires.

gaps.sentence: The scheme is costly; on the ___ hand, it would create hundreds of jobs.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' balances a drawback against an advantage.

gaps.sentence: My sister is terribly reserved, ___ I'll talk to complete strangers.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' contrasts two parallel facts: her nature versus mine.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: I know exactly what the risks are. ___, I'm going anyway.
gaps.hint: doing it in spite of risk

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we arrived ___ the storm broke.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly... when' is the fixed pair for one event interrupting another.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.
